items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, lowering lithium companies' target prices following recent spot price weakness, though BMO continues to view the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. Albemarle maintained its 2026 outlook, expecting the high end of scenario ranges, and achieved $100 million in run-rate savings year to date.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory and expected supply from mine restarts; energy storage demand remains resilient.
